usedFor: inflow-inventory holds your sales orders and Notion holds your pages, so “New Sales Order Created” can run “Create Page”.

bestTemplate.name: “New Sales Order Created” in inflow-inventory, then “Create Page” in Notion
bestTemplate.why: Each new sales order gets its own Notion page, so your team can track it in the workspace.

watchOut: “Update Customer” fires on every edit, so using it with “Create Page” can make several pages for one customer.
